onboarding.title: WELCOME TO THE PIDOTS OPERATIONAL CONSOLE
onboarding.subtitle: Practical operational navigation guide for console and edge resources.
onboarding.toast_completed: Operational walkthrough completed successfully. Good work!

step1.title: ACTIVITY RAIL & SPACES COORDINATION
step1.what: Vertical 48px Activity Rail with 5 operational contexts (Spaces, Dots, Tasks, Memory, and Configs) and an artifact directory persisted to SQLite WAL.
step1.how: Click rail icons to switch context panes or select a Space to load files, documents, and system specs directly onto the canvas.
step1.tip: Press <kbd>Alt+1</kbd> through <kbd>Alt+5</kbd> to toggle context panes or <kbd>Ctrl+B</kbd> to collapse the left sidebar.

step2.title: REACT TELETYPE & COMMAND TERMINAL
step2.what: Conversational mission dispatch console with continuous pin-feed paper ticker, Source Input Bar with channel and active agent tags, and ReAct scratchpad.
step2.how: Type <kbd>/</kbd> or click the <kbd>/</kbd> button to open the slash commands catalog; type <kbd>@</kbd> to summon autonomous coworker specialists.
step2.tip: Press <kbd>Enter</kbd> to transmit instructions, <kbd>Shift+Enter</kbd> for line breaks, or <kbd>Ctrl+L</kbd> to wipe the paper ticker.

step3.title: DOT'S COMPUTER & BUBBLEWRAP SANDBOX
step3.what: Local execution environment secured by Linux Bubblewrap (bwrap) in /workspace, ensuring coworkers manipulate files without endangering the host node.
step3.how: Inspect the active Dot workspace directory in the top console banner and click <kbd>[Observation Mode]</kbd> to assume terminal control (Takeover).
step3.tip: Sandbox operates as a native ARM64 process with strict read/write boundaries and network isolation for unvetted actions.

step4.title: LIVE CANVAS & 4 OPERATIONAL TABS
step4.what: High-density technical workbench organized into 4 strict tabs: Artifact (Spaces & Diffs), CoAgents (Shared State), Terminal, and HITL Governance.
step4.how: Switch between tabs to inspect agent plan state, review execution logs, and authorize pending commands in the HITL queue.
step4.tip: Press <kbd>Alt+I</kbd> to focus the active artifact, <kbd>Alt+H</kbd> to open the HITL authorization panel, or <kbd>Ctrl+S</kbd> to save revisions to the WAL database.

step5.title: ARM64 TELEMETRY & AI HOT-RELOAD
step5.what: Operational hardware and AI model control hub. Update inference keys and base endpoints on-the-fly without restarting the edge process.
step5.how: Monitor real-time vector graphs for RSS RAM (300MB ceiling) and SoC temperature, adjust inference settings, and test connections instantly.
step5.tip: Press <kbd>Alt+5</kbd> or click the ASCII telemetry footer to open configuration settings; press <kbd>F1</kbd> to display the Technical Manual.

onboarding.step1_desc: piDots turns your edge device into a smart workstation. Lightweight async Python monolith running multiple specialists using under 70 MB RAM.
onboarding.step2_desc: Speak directly to coworkers by typing @coder for code, @architect for docs, and @auditor for command review. The supervisor delegates work with zero extra setup.
onboarding.step3_desc: Files, code diffs, and diagrams appear in the right-side canvas without cluttering the chat. Inspect diffs and restore revisions at any time.
onboarding.step4_desc: High-risk operational commands (such as deleting files or modifying system configs) are paused immediately. You review parameters before granting execution.
onboarding.step5_desc: Fast navigation: F1 opens the manual, Alt+I inspects artifacts, Ctrl+L clears the ticker. Install as PWA on mobile or desktop for full-screen mode.
